boundary: Read-only fresh hashes and retained primitive/image measurements. No Flutter job, source/test/comparator/image change, native action, runtime operation or owner acceptance. Existing r13 execution is historical and current lock drift is separate.

environment.testBackend: flutter_tester software rendering / skia-deterministic-rendering (SDK source default)

diagnosis.confirmed: SDK/runtime rounded-border raster output differs for identical text-free primitive input and byte-identical border/radius painting source. All 65 inspected screen differences are localized rounded-border segments/corners, with unchanged dimensions and no changed labels, values or icons in isolated diffs; candidates match earlier retained controls.
diagnosis.notEstablished: The exact engine/Skia change and producing SDK provenance of each approved PNG; no unchanged-current-source complete-screen old/current SDK A/B was executed. Skia DEPS revisions differ, but that alone does not identify the causative commit.
diagnosis.oldFull65Feasibility: Unsupported unchanged workspace: old Dart 3.12.2 / Flutter 3.44.7 violates desktop pubspec/lock and eight package-config language versions. Lowering constraints, language metadata or dependency versions is a controlled fixture overlay and cannot prove ordinary supported current-app behavior. No such overlay was made.
diagnosis.historicalCiTransition: At commit 0b2261f (2026-09-16) CI used Flutter 3.44.7 and desktop required Dart ^3.12.2. Commit 7c08ea8 (2026-10-03) updated CI to 3.47.5. Quotation baseline last changed e35a05e (2026-09-09); supplier statement baseline last changed 0b2261f. Git chronology supports the hypothesis but does not prove execution provenance.

risks.issue: 65 strict approved baselines differ from supported-SDK raster output; an owner visual decision is still required.
Current pubspec.lock differs from r13; fresh current-lock candidate execution is required before current-source strict verification.
CI quality tests run on Ubuntu while retained r13 goldens ran on Windows; Windows strict evidence cannot establish Linux strict success.

proposedResolution.strategy: Freeze a candidate using current source/current lock and exact Flutter3.47.5 engine/font hashes; retain the strict comparator; render and compare candidates to these 65 exact reviewed r13 hashes. Present every old/current/diff in the combined 83-case owner packet. After an explicit decision bound to candidate paths/hashes, replace only the individually approved baseline PNGs and rerun strict current-source desktop tests without --update-goldens.
